text:
Maya: Morning — quick gate check for the Optimize toolkit deliverable. Are we green on quant recs, batching, and cache regression tests? Need owners for any blocking items.
Raj: Infra found an edge in the L2 KV cache when prefixes are reused across sessions. Patch in PR #58, needs eng-runtime review. @Taylor can you take this review?
Taylor: I can. Quick local perf notes: int8 path on A100-80GB shows ~1.2x throughput vs baseline after the change. main risk is kernel compatibility for long sequences.
Sasha: QA ran the regression suite on the canary and saw a ~0.3% perplexity drift on the 'docs-regen' prompt set. Logging issue #342 with sample diffs.
infra-bot: deploy:canary started for optkit-v2 in us-west-2 — build #789. https://ci.redwood/build/789 :rocket:
Maya: Plan: if Taylor + Raj + Sasha sign off by EOD, we push canary to 50% and monitor latency/cost dashboards. Otherwise hold. Action items: Taylor (PR review), Raj (merge hotfix), Sasha (regression triage).
Taylor: Done with first pass, left a small test-flakiness nit. ETA merge ~2h after CI rerun.
Raj: Hotfix merged into feature/kv-fix; will trigger a new canary build. Requesting deploy window 3–4pm PST for traffic ramp.
Sasha: Triage update: drift looks tied to quant calibration (we switched to median-based calibration in the last profile). Rolling back to mean-based reduces the drift. Opening PR to pin calibration profile.
Maya: Good catch. Also tagging product for visibility — @Kevin this could affect a few low-latency routes; not user-facing yet but wanted to flag.
Kevin: Noted. Keep me posted — I can pause rollout if customer-facing SLAs look at risk.
Taylor: Merged PR, CI passed. infra-bot shows new canary pipeline starting.
infra-bot: canary metrics (build #790): latency avg +2ms, p99 +5ms, cost per-token -9%. Regression alert: docs-regen perplexity +0.32%. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/optkit/790
Maya: Decision: proceed to 50% at 17:00 UTC if no new regressions. Sasha — if the calibration pin reduces drift, we proceed. Thanks all :handshake:
Sasha: Running extended regression now: command I'm using:
```
pytest tests/regression::docs-regen -k quant --runslow --junitxml=out.xml
```
Will post numbers in ~45m.
Maya: Awesome, please paste the key diffs in this thread. If we stay within 0.5% perplexity drift and no latency tail spikes, we go.
Taylor: ACK. I'll keep an eye on kernel failures during the ramp. Ping if you need me to roll back.
Raj: I'll watch canary lag and autoscaler behavior during 50% ramp. Will DM if I see queue buildup.
Sasha: First pass complete: pinned calibration drops the docs-regen drift to +0.08%. Detailed diff uploaded to issue #342. Recommend proceeding.
Maya: Excellent — proceeding with 50% at 17:00 UTC. Tagging infra for the ramp: @infra-bot please execute ramp to 50% at scheduled time and post metrics.
infra-bot: scheduled ramp to 50% at 17:00 UTC. Will post metrics and any regression alerts here.
Maya: Great work team, summary action items: Taylor (monitor kernels/deploy), Raj (observe autoscaler), Sasha (follow regressions), Kevin (product FYI). Will reconvene if anything spikes. :tada:
